newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ATHLETICS/SKI JUMPING-GOLDBERGER AND KIESEL WIN AUSTRIAN AWARDS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS/SKI JUMPING-GOLDBERGER AND KIESEL WIN AUSTRIAN AWARDS.

text.p: Ski jumper Andreas Goldberger and middle distance runner Theresia Kiesel have been voted Austrian sportsman and sportswoman of the year respectively by national journalists.
Goldberger, winner of the same award in 1993, won the overall ski jumping World Cup as well as the gold medal at the ski flying world championships.
Kiesel claimed Austria's first Olympic track medal when took the 1,500 metres bronze in Atlanta.
